The ward on printed page 38 is a ward of the CITY of 1839 and places no house in the town of 1835. The Illinois State Archives' Public Domain Land Tract Sales register enters this person 4 times, as “OWEN THOMAS J V”, 1833-10-23 to 1833-10-24: 4 parcels of the school section — BL105 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E), as read; BL108 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E), as read; lot 1 of block 84 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E); lot 3 of block 23 of the school section (sec 16 T39N R14E), 8.72 acres stated in all, for $676.00 (ls0297, ls0298, ls0299, ls0300).
